dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: *sigh* I should really decide on a budget before starting an experiment next time... Managing a project is so much harder than working on the experiment itself...

dialogues.speaker: Jami
dialogues.text: #How was it, {NICKNAME}? Did the experiment go smoothly?

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: The Fayz Potion is pretty amazing, huh? It's a shame that it only works in specific environments.

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: If I could improve the versatility of the Fayz Potion, it would definitely become a popular research topic. Hmm, improving its versatility...

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Curses, why didn't I think of that earlier? I could've just researched that instead!

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Ugh, the more I think about it, the more I regret choosing my current topic...

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Yeah, sorry for not explaining clearly... But why would you be interested in this?

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Anyway, the project I'm currently working on is called "A Study on the Defense Deficiencies of Biological Structures in Response to Hostile Stressors."

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Simply put, I'm researching the weaknesses revealed by creatures during combat and defense behaviors in dangerous environments.

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: It's like when a Rishboland Tiger comes leaping at you and you quickly slip under its tummy to dodge its attack... Weird analogy, I know, but that's basically how it is.

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: I wanted to study creatures active across larger areas, and many of those creatures are native to Liyue. That's why I chose to set up my experimental site here.

response.speaker: Jami
response.text: Ah, okay then. I hope everything goes smoothly... Please stay safe!
